name: No Pedestrians
spec: white square with a black walking-person symbol inside a red circle with a red diagonal slash

snippets.back: After a complete stop you may turn right on red if no pedestrians or traffic are in the way, unless a No Right Turn On Red sign is posted.
On a steady red, stop behind the crosswalk or stop line; unless a sign forbids it, you may then turn right once no pedestrians or cross traffic are present.

result.summary: Neither snippet names or describes the No Pedestrians sign; both discuss right turn on red and yielding to pedestrians, with no statement of the sign's meaning or spec.
